name: Server-Side Template Injection
attack_scenario: user input is placed into the template SOURCE (not passed as data), so the template engine evaluates attacker markup — a full remote-code-execution path in Jinja2/Mako/Handlebars
negative_test_hint: submit "{{7*7}}" (Jinja) or "{{constructor.constructor('return process')()}}" and assert it is not evaluated

exemplar.explanation: pass user data as context variables to a fixed template; never build the template source from user input
